$description: Brand primitives shared byte-for-byte by BOTH the operator console (umi-dashboard) and the marketing site (umi-landing-page). These are the only genuinely cross-app values; every other token is app-scoped (see dashboard.json / landing.json). App tokens reference these with the DTCG alias syntax {color.navy}.

navy.$description: Azul Marino UMI — primary brand navy. dashboard --umi-navy · landing umi-blue.dark

blue.$description: Azul UMI — brand blue. dashboard --umi-blue / --info · landing umi-light-blue.DEFAULT / umi-blue.light

size.$description: Pointer-target sizes, in px, shared by BOTH clients so the operator console and the marketing site agree on one floor. control-min is the hard minimum: every actionable control measures at least 44 x 44 px (plan 5.2, "Minimum control 44 x 44 pt", Apple HIG / WCAG 2.5.5). control-tap is the higher floor this product wants wherever a hand, not a cursor, drives the screen.

control-min.$description: Minimum pointer target — 44 px on both axes; nothing actionable may measure below it.

control-tap.$description: Preferred tap floor for touch-driven surfaces (plan 5.2 tap floor).
